summary: Install repository-local core and optional TDD skills, with explicit updates that preserve local edits and project instructions. Add CLI install/status/update commands, self-install both skills without making TDD the default, and describe and test the installation behavior.

examined.reason: Replaces the checkout-only availability limitation with repository-local installation, explicit updates and optional workflow selection. Summary now reflects those promises.
Core skill routes to project instructions and a chosen optional TDD supplement while preserving description, evidence and acceptance responsibilities. Exact links include that guidance.
Adds separate discoverable install, status and update operations, each with a child anchored to its own sentence. The CLI remains structured and does not choose the development approach.
Help now lists the three implemented skill commands and optional tdd argument. Its exact text link is refreshed.
New supplement describes meaningful test-first evidence and appropriate checks without imposing TDD or fixed levels. It defers review and acceptance to the core skill.
New command validates options before installation and returns written paths and states; default installation includes only core.
New read-only command reports installed, local and bundled differences and rejects invalid records and paths.
New explicit update command considers recorded skills only, preserves local modifications and deletions, and leaves changes uncommitted.

New implementation and description account for exact content comparison, installed hashes, all-file conflict preflight, preserved custom files, path checks and the limit of ordinary filesystem writes.
Acceptance dispatch and exact ready identity checks are unchanged. Importing the installer has no filesystem side effects.
Check-result retrieval still reads the same local result store; skill installation bookkeeping is separate.
Check-result validation and recording dispatch are unchanged; new installer status does not claim verification evidence.
Readiness withdrawal and retained edits are unchanged; skill installation is an ordinary worktree change.
Snapshot construction, supplied decisions and impact calculation are unchanged; new descriptions use the existing model.
The same projection now naturally lists the five new descriptions; no new hierarchy representation is introduced.
Explicit file selection, evidence matching and review preparation dispatch are unchanged; installed skills are ordinary proposed files.
The saved ready-record read is unchanged; installation has no separate acceptance authority.
Description inspection and its neighborhood are unchanged; the new skill descriptions use the existing shape.
Snapshot selection still captures eligible working files, including repository-local skills, without moving HEAD or staging.
Working and historical source reads are unchanged; bundled skills are ordinary source content.
The semantic-selection request and session channel are untouched by the new command branch.
Navigation validation and optional revision/passage request are unchanged; skills do not add a UI workflow mode.
The same structural and passage validation applies to the new descriptions and test links.
Product and format identification remain the same; skill installation adds commands without changing the project format.
The core still requires summaries to agree with full descriptions. Workflow choice and skill installation do not change summary storage or meaning.

The existing agent-skills responsibility already covers guidance around investigation and changes. Local installation and optional TDD elaborate that responsibility without expanding review authority.

results.method: npm run typecheck; npm test; node src/cli.ts validate; skill-creator quick_validate.py for both skills; installed/bundled byte comparison
results.environment: macOS, Node v24.16.0, TypeScript; Python 3.13 for the skill frontmatter validator
results.evidence: Final unchanged proposal: full unit/CLI suite passed 32 tests, 0 failures; all 31 cataloged unit-test names matched successful output. Typecheck, project validation, both skill validators, and installed/bundled comparisons passed. Installer scenarios include an invalid unselected workflow being rejected before core or record writes, as well as selected-file conflicts, local deletions, optional TDD and preserved project instructions. The added unselected-file regression reproduced an initial partial-installation error; that is fixed, and an ensuing fixture-cleanup mistake was corrected before this full successful run. Logs: /private/tmp/stratic-skills-suite-verified.txt and /private/tmp/stratic-skills-typecheck.txt; earlier failed runs are retained separately. No desktop suite was run because desktop implementation is unchanged. Skill validation establishes structure, not future agent judgment.

unmapped.reason: The new import connects the linked skill command branch to the installer. Importing the module computes constants only; it performs no installation or project mutation.
Imports, fixture setup and the subprocess helper support the three individually linked installer scenarios. They are test scaffolding, not another product responsibility.
